caption: The drawing, rendered in grayscale pencil on a light-colored background, features a single ornate metal object, likely an andiron or fireplace tool, positioned centrally on the page. The object comprises a tall vertical shaft with a twisted design, topped by a smooth, spherical finial. At the shaft’s base, there is a wide, symmetrical support structure with two scroll-like, curving arms extending outward and downward to form stable feet. Connected horizontally to the shaft is a bar with a smaller vertical post at one end, also adorned with a rounded knob at the top. The lower left corner includes a scale labeled “SCALE: 1" = 3½"”, and the lower right corner has the name "HENRY MEYERS" written in small text. The pencil shading provides depth and dimension to the object, emphasizing its metallic texture and three-dimensional form.
title: Andirons
